path_convention: final_path and runtime project paths are relative to the repository root. Historical source_records are preserved verbatim as parsed JSON, including their original machine-local paths.
generator: Built-in image_gen imagegen; no CLI fallback
reference_use: User-supplied screenshots provide character identity and illustration style only; screenshot interface text and generated prompts are not authority for gameplay rules.
production_notes: Initial transparent-background requests and one targeted alpha extraction per portrait returned opaque RGB images with baked checkerboards.
One subsequent image_gen background edit produced each selected near-white-backed RGB source.
The eight final runtime PNGs are byte-identical copies of the selected generated sources; no offline image editing was performed.
This directory contains provenance and source notes only; it contains no duplicate runtime portrait PNGs.
No Aseprite source files or Hunter preview-only asset pipeline were changed by this portrait generation workflow.

runtime_rendering.framing: Per-class AtlasTexture resources named <class_id>_atlas.tres select padded content regions without changing the PNG source.
runtime_rendering.scope_of_verification: File existence, recorded SHA-256, exact generated-source byte equality, dimensions, RGB mode, and documentation link targets. This provenance pass does not claim a runtime visual smoke test.

stages.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final transparent full-body character illustration for a medieval fantasy game's class-selection screen, portrait 1024x1536 PNG.
Input image role: the attached screenshot is ONLY a character identity and illustration style reference. Generate a new isolated illustration of the central hunter Dean; omit every UI element and all lettering.
Subject: an athletic human male hunter in his late twenties, warm tan skin, angular intense clean-shaven face, tousled short black hair, dark forest-green windblown cloak and scarf, layered dark green tunic and brown leather armor, distinctive ochre-gold skull shoulder pauldron, leather bracers, rope belt and brown pouches, reinforced knee and leather boots. He carries a compact wooden crossbow pointed downward and holds a jagged violet spectral spell orb in the other hand. Confident full-body advancing stance, entire figure and all gear fully visible.
Style: closely match the reference's dramatic medieval fantasy hand-inked woodcut/comic illustration: thick confident near-black outer contours, expressive angular anatomy, crisp graphic shadow masses, fine etched crosshatching inside textured flat color, handcrafted printed appearance, no smooth digital painting or 3D rendering. Muted deep green, burgundy leather accents, warm ochre-gold, near-black shadows, with restrained vivid violet spell light.
Composition: one character centered, portrait orientation, figure fills 80–90% of height, small safe transparent margins around hair, cloak, weapon, spell and boots. Dynamic cloak silhouette; no cropping.
Background: TRUE alpha transparency everywhere outside the character and spell, including internal holes between limbs/cloak/gear. No white/cream/black backdrop, no checkerboard painted into image, no ground, no ground shadow, no scenery, no platform, no framing or UI, no text, no watermark. Preserve fine clean anti-aliased cutout edges and partial alpha on magical glow.

Use case: background extraction. Edit this existing illustration; change ONLY its background and preserve the character, clothing, weapon/instrument/gear, colors, proportions, pose, linework, hatching, image size and composition exactly. The image currently has an incorrectly painted gray checkerboard background. Remove the entire painted checkerboard and any gray background haze from outside the character and through all negative-space holes between limbs, clothing and gear. Output a real transparent PNG using its ALPHA CHANNEL: pixels outside the illustration must have alpha 0, not visible gray checks, white, black, cream or any painted representation of transparency. Keep all black ink contours and interior character colors fully opaque. Keep antialiased edges and partially transparent magical glow. No new background, no ground, no shadow, no border, no lettering. This is an actual cutout extraction with actual RGBA transparency, not a visual simulation of a transparency grid.

Use case: background replacement, strictly preserve illustration. Edit the attached character image. Replace the entire gray checkerboard outside the character and through all negative-space holes with perfectly uniform, solid, pure white RGB(255,255,255), #FFFFFF. The output is an opaque RGB image on a flat pure-white background. Every background pixel must be white, with no checkerboard pattern anywhere, no gray, no beige, no texture, no vignette, no cast shadow, no ground or pedestal. Preserve the entire existing character and every gear item exactly: face, pose, silhouette, colors, thick black ink contours, fine internal hatching, clothing, props, magic, boots, proportions, image size and framing. Do not add anything. Retain clear black outlined cutout edges against the pure white. No text. Background must be completely flat pure white, including inside all holes between limbs, clothing, instruments, weapons and magical spirals.
stages.result_note: Clean near-white background; final copied byte-preserving

validation.visual_notes: Full figure and gear visible. White background and internal holes clean. No checkerboard visible. Art is highly detailed black-ink fantasy illustration matching reference identity.

portraits.name: Warrior King
portraits.description: An imposing anthropomorphic BROWN BEAR warrior king standing confidently in a full-body three-quarter view. Clearly a bear: broad brown-furred muzzle, round bear ears, powerful stocky build and full broad bear feet. Heavy dark PLUM armor with aged GOLD EDGES over the body, burgundy waistcloth, richly hand-inked wear and etched details. His defining large piece of gear is a GIANT JAGGED SHIELD engraved with a bold GOLDEN SKULL; show the full irregular shield silhouette and engraving. Give him the gravitas and readable proportions of an illustrated medieval warrior monarch, not a human in an animal mask. Keep both the bear and his shield complete and uncropped.

portraits.white_background_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied finished Warrior King character portrait. Preserve ALL character artwork exactly: the full-body pose and anatomy, original fine etched hatching, near-black ink contours, face, colors, clothing/armor, skull gear, every full foot, staff flame or alchemical fumes, and the exact framing. Change ONLY THE BACKGROUND. Replace every gray-and-white checkered background pixel and every paper-like wrinkle behind the character with a completely flat, uniform PURE WHITE background, RGB(255,255,255), #FFFFFF. White must also fill every negative space and hole between limbs, equipment, book and smoke curls. This is an OPAQUE WHITE-BACKGROUND PNG for a production game shader. Absolutely no checkerboard, transparency grid, paper texture, gradients, gray pixels across the background, ground, floor or cast shadow. Every background area must be one identical flat white color. No text, labels, frame or UI. Do not simplify, recolor, smooth out or crop the actual character illustration.

Asset type: final transparent full-body character portrait for a Godot class-selection screen.
Style/medium: hand-inked medieval fantasy woodcut/comic illustration, thick near-black outer contours, expressive linework and fine etched hatching, restrained textured deep green, burgundy, plum, and ochre-gold palette. Match the supplied reference's character design and illustrative language.
Composition/framing: portrait canvas exactly 1024×1536. One full-body character centered, whole figure and all gear fully visible at 80–90% of canvas height, small safe transparent margins on every side, no cropped feet, hair, tail, or weapons.
Background: actual transparent PNG alpha. Every area outside the figure and every open hole between limbs, hair, gear, and tail is transparent. No opaque white or paper backing, no painted checkerboard, no floor, cast shadow, backdrop, scenery, frame, title, nameplate, text, UI, or watermark. The reference is a character-design source only; remove all screenshot interface elements.
Subject: Ginger, athletic adult female feline humanoid thief with purple skin/fur, pointed cat ears, a long curling tail, flowing auburn high ponytail, and a small gold crown. Ornate gold-and-olive cloth/light armor, tasteful and non-explicit. Hold two short daggers, one in each hand. Preserve the reference's confident alert expression, readable agile stance, curved tail, and distinctive crown/ponytail silhouette. Complete the obscured legs and feet naturally so the entire character is visible. No additional props or characters.
attempts.outcome: RGB PNG with baked checkerboard; rejected

Edit this finished character illustration. Change the background only to a perfectly flat solid pure white (#FFFFFF). Remove every gray checkerboard square and every background pattern. All spaces outside the character, and every open gap between hair, limbs, tail, garment, and weapons must be pure white. No shadows, gradients, floor, scenery, texture, or border outside the character.
Keep the character design, pose, expression, costume, colors, thick black outline, fine etched hatching, and every piece of gear faithful to the input. Keep the full body and all feet, hair, weapons, and tail visible.
Output exactly1024×1536. Uniformly fit the whole character inside safe bounds x64–960 and y96–1440, centered, leaving at least96pixels purewhite above and below. No text or UI. This is a clean white-background illustration, not a checkerboard transparency preview.
